explanation: The outer loop runs i from 0 to 3, and for each i the inner loop runs j from 0 to 3. The continue skips every pair where i + j is even, so only pairs with an odd sum ever reach the print. Because the inner loop always finishes all four j values before the outer loop advances to the next i, the surviving pairs print in row-major order: both odd-sum pairs for i=0 before either one for i=1, and so on.
prompt: Drag these prints into the order they actually happen.
